notes.title: Steam Friend Invitation Feature Added
notes.content: [p]In this update, we have implemented a feature that allows you to send invitations directly from your Steam friends list.[/p][p]This enables you to join games smoothly through your Steam friends, in addition to the traditional server ID search method. [/p][p][/p][p]If you are unable to search by server ID, please use the invitation feature from your Steam friends list.[/p][p]We will continue to make improvements to ensure an even more comfortable gameplay experience.[/p]

notes.title: Regarding the Issue Connecting to Multiplayer
notes.content:
[p]Some players are currently experiencing issues connecting to multiplayer.
We are actively investigating the cause, but in the meantime, here are some possible solutions:[/p][h3]🔧 Temporary Solutions[/h3][list][*][p][b]Change Download Region[/b]
Setting the Steam “Download Region” to the same as the person you're playing with may help resolve the connection issue.
How to set: Steam Client → Settings → Downloads → Download Region[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Reinstall the Game[/b]
Uninstalling and reinstalling the game may resolve the issue.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Update the Steam Client[/b]
Updating the Steam client to the latest version may help resolve the issue.[/p][/*][/list][p]We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.
We will continue to investigate and address the issue.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of [i]MustScream[/i].[/p]
